Urban Gardening Enthusiast T-Shirt Design Hypothesis
HYPOTHESIS - no proven Amazon demand; not approved.
Why explored (model hypothesis): Targets individuals interested in small-space cultivation and plant care, allowing for bold shapes representing foliage or tools rendered with high contrast flat ink. Observed 5 attributed listings; title patterns only. Concept passed required-field/citation checks; no market-success score. Sample has 5 distinct title strings, 5 creators, 0 repeated title groups; not a sales/competition metric.
Observed basis selected by model: E1: observed title Urban gardening mens t shirts farming; E3: observed title Gardening - Engaging in urban gardening, guerrilla T-Shirt
Audience: Urban Gardening Enthusiasts who value practical, hands-on cultivation in small spaces.
Occasion: A bold statement piece for community gardeners and balcony farmers expressing their dedication to local food production.
Print wording: Roots Run Deep
Idea: The design utilizes a dark forest green ink and charcoal black ink printed with high contrast against a light garment color. The composition is strictly flat with no gradients or shadows. All areas of the fabric not covered by the text or geometric shapes remain explicitly transparent (alpha zero), revealing the base garment material without any white under-base or tinted fill.
Design: The proposed artwork consists of a central typographic layout where the words 'ROOTS' appear in large, bold Forest Green letters stacked above 'RUN DEEP' in Charcoal Black. The geometric shapes below are also flat ink in Forest Green. This high-contrast arrangement is set against a Light Heather Grey garment to ensure maximum readability. All unprinted areas of the fabric must be explicitly transparent (alpha zero), meaning no white background or tinted fill is applied; only the specific text and shapes carry ink.

The letters are slightly spaced apart to create a modern, breathable look. Below this central text block, three small, solid geometric shapes (a circle, a square, and a triangle) are arranged horizontally, representing different plant forms or soil layers.",
    "illustration":  "Bold, high-contrast flat ink shapes with no internal detail or texture. The text is solid and readable from a distance. The geometric shapes are simple and distinct.",
    "ink_palette":  [
                        "Flat Forest Green",
                        "Flat Charcoal Black"
                    ]
}
Sources:

E2 | StevenzTeQShop | https://www.zazzle.com/i_wear_teal_and_purple_for_my_brother_suicide_prev_t_shirt-256698647453655967
E3 | Lylah_Drusilla | https://www.zazzle.com/gardening_engaging_in_urban_gardening_guerrilla_t_shirt-256687572343146084
E4 | GreenApronSoc | https://www.zazzle.com/urban_oasis_greenhouse_retro_geometric_garden_t_t_shirt-256694415859574686
E5 | taborndovievip1120 | https://www.zazzle.com/urban_farming_for_urban_farmer_t_shirt-256105169905085859
Limits: Zazzle text sample only; motives, advantages, visuals, rights, print quality and sales remain unverified.
РЕШЕНИЯ ВЛАДЕЛЬЦА:
1. Одобрить или отредактировать готовую идею и концепт кнопкой Approve idea and design. Сейчас approval отсутствует.
2. Проверить точные буквы, регистр и пунктуацию строки Print wording: это обязательная строка для будущего изображения; её расхождение с описанием композиции нужно исправить перед approval.
3. После разрешённой генерации проверить результат через Qwen (CPU), затем лично принять конкретный файл.
4. Подготовить прозрачный sRGB PNG; проверить читаемость и края в конечном размере печати и права. 4500x5400 — рекомендованный холст; увеличение 512px не доказывает качество.
5. Только после отдельных проверок экспорт станет READY; публикация остаётся ручной и не выполняется Forge.

Night Sky Observation Tee Hypothesis
HYPOTHESIS - no proven Amazon demand; not approved.
Why explored (model hypothesis): Serves those who observe celestial bodies at night, enabling composition focused on star charts or planetary orbits without implying specific fabric material properties. Observed 5 attributed listings; title patterns only. Concept passed required-field/citation checks; no market-success score. Sample has 5 distinct title strings, 5 creators, 0 repeated title groups; not a sales/competition metric.
Observed basis selected by model: E1: observed title Funny Jesus Stargazing Stargaze T-Shirt
Audience: Amateur Astronomy Hobbyists seeking a shirt for their next backyard telescope session or local star party.
Occasion: A bold statement to wear while pointing a telescope at the night sky, distinguishing serious observation from casual looking.
Print wording: LOOKING UP, NOT DOWN
Idea: The design utilizes a deep Void Black garment to simulate the night sky. The text 'LOOKING UP' and 'NOT DOWN' is rendered in Electric Lime Green using a thick, sans-serif font for maximum legibility from a distance or in dim light. A bright cyan outline defines a telescope silhouette on the left side of the chest, contrasting sharply against the dark fabric. The starburst element on the right uses solid flat Cyan ink without any white highlights, ensuring the design remains simple and durable. All areas surrounding the artwork and the entire back of the garment remain explicitly transparent (alpha zero), allowing the dark fabric color to show through completely.
Design: The proposed artwork is printed on a deep Void Black crew-neck t-shirt. The ink palette consists of flat Electric Lime Green for the primary text and bright Cyan for the secondary graphics. The composition places the bold lettering centrally on the chest with high contrast against the dark background. All unprinted areas, including the sleeves, collar, and back panel, are explicitly transparent (alpha zero), revealing the full depth of the black fabric without any white underbase or light ink overlays.
